sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:229

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:229:1
items.html: There is a difficulty for the third interpretation from every place, that on weekdays all the Mochin are only from YESHSUT, etc.: We have already spoken of this just above, that the third interpretation speaks specifically of the great ZON, who return face to face only with the Mochin of the upper AVI, meaning in truth only on the Sabbath and Passover. But the small ZON, Jacob and Rachel, whose aspect of Haya and face to face they receive from YESHSUT, which comprises all the aspects of the couplings of festivals and weekdays — of them the third interpretation does not speak, as above.
